title: The number of studies per class at which heterogeneity structures become distinguishable
question: How many studies per class are needed before model comparison reliably distinguishes a shared between-study variance from class-specific ones?
design: Two classes of 2 to 40 studies each with between-study variance ratio 1, 2 or 5; shared and separate REML fits compared by AIC, BIC and a likelihood-ratio test. 21 cells, 2000 replicates each.
